title: E-Code Additives
short_message: This product contains E-coded additives. BOTIA flags them when they're relevant to understand the product.
what_detected: BOTIA found relevant E codes: E120 (carmine), E407 (carrageenan), E471 (mono- and diglycerides), E621 (MSG), E950/E951/E954/E955 (sweeteners), E420/E421/E953/E965/E966/E967/E968 (sugar alcohols), or other E codes flagged for ingredient interest.
why_it_matters: E codes are the EU/international system for naming food additives. They appear on labels in Europe and many other regions. Many people want to know when a product contains additives beyond basic ingredients. Some E codes link to specific concerns: E120 is insect-derived, E407 is texture-heavy, E621 is a flavor intensifier. BOTIA connects them to the relevant alert category when applicable. If no category applies, BOTIA flags it so you can research it yourself.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot tell you E codes are harmful or that this product is unsafe. E codes are regulated and approved. BOTIA only flags them so you can see what's actually in your food.
source_note: E codes are assigned by the European Commission and recognized internationally. Check EFSA (European Food Safety Authority) if you want detailed info on any specific code.
